svg.title: End-to-end run time before and after fast-anything, two Python apps
svg.desc: Fuzzy dedupe example: 2.58 s in Python, 17 ms with the Rust port, 150 times faster. Paragraph dedupe over my blog posts: 380 ms in Python, 104 ms with the Rust port, 3.6 times faster. Log scale.

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Same tool, same box, very different wins

text.font-family: Work Sans, Inter, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Whole-app run time, median of 5 interleaved runs from fast-anything bench. Log scale: each gridline is 10x.

svg.text: Source: my runs of fast-anything 0.8.0 on an 8-vCPU Linux box, Python 3.13.5, Rust 1.85.1, 2026-11-23. Example app from the fast-anything repo, port = its reference lib.rs.
